<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../config/config.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../utils/exceptions.php';

use Firebase\JWT\JWT;
use Firebase\JWT\Key;
use Firebase\JWT\ExpiredException;

/**
 * AUTHENTICATION middleware – "who are you?"
 *
 * Registered on a route or a group:  ->addMiddleware(new AuthMiddleware())
 * FlightPHP calls before() BEFORE the route function runs.
 *
 *  - no token / invalid token / expired token -> 401 (UnauthorizedException)
 *  - valid token -> the user from the token is stored in Flight::get('user')
 */
class AuthMiddleware
{
    public function before($params)
    {
        $token = $this->read_token();
        if (!$token) {
            throw new UnauthorizedException('Missing authentication token.');
        }

        try {
            $decoded = JWT::decode($token, new Key(Config::JWT_SECRET(), 'HS256'));
        } catch (ExpiredException $e) {
            throw new UnauthorizedException('Your session has expired. Please log in again.');
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid authentication token.');
        }

        // Available in every route and service call: Flight::get('user')['id'], ['role']...
        Flight::set('user', (array) $decoded->user);
    }

    /** Header format:  Authorization: Bearer <token> */
    private function read_token()
    {
        $header = Flight::request()->getHeader('Authorization');
        if (!$header) {
            // Some Apache setups move the header to this variable (see .htaccess)
            $header = $_SERVER['REDIRECT_HTTP_AUTHORIZATION'] ?? '';
        }
        if (preg_match('/^Bearer\s+(\S+)$/i', $header, $matches)) {
            return $matches[1];
        }
        return null;
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../utils/Logger.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../utils/exceptions.php';

/**
 * ERROR HANDLING middleware – catches every exception that was not handled elsewhere.
 *
 * Registered once in index.php:  Flight::map('error', [new ErrorMiddleware(), 'handle'])
 *
 *  - HttpException (thrown on purpose)  -> its status code + its message
 *  - anything else (PDOException, bug)  -> 500 + a GENERIC message
 *  - 401/403/500 are written to logs/error.log
 *  - the client NEVER sees stack traces, SQL or file paths
 */
class ErrorMiddleware
{
    public function handle(Throwable $e)
    {
        if ($e instanceof HttpException) {
            $status = $e->get_status();
            $message = $e->getMessage();
            if (in_array($status, [401, 403])) {
                $this->log($status, $message);          // rejected requests
            }
        } else {
            $status = 500;
            $message = 'Something went wrong on the server. Please try again later.';
            // Full details only in OUR log: class, message, file and line
            $this->log($status, sprintf('%s: %s (%s:%d)', get_class($e), $e->getMessage(), basename($e->getFile()), $e->getLine()));
        }

        $this->send_json($status, ['error' => $message]);
    }

    public function not_found()
    {
        $this->send_json(404, ['error' => 'Endpoint not found.']);
    }

    private function log($status, $message)
    {
        $request = Flight::request();
        $user = Flight::has('user') ? Flight::get('user') : null;
        Logger::error(sprintf(
            '%s %s %d user=%s role=%s %s',
            $request->method,
            parse_url($request->url, PHP_URL_PATH),
            $status,
            $user['id'] ?? '-',
            $user['role'] ?? '-',
            $message
        ));
    }

    private function send_json($status, $body)
    {
        Flight::response()
            ->clearBody()
            ->status($status)
            ->header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
            ->write(json_encode($body))
            ->send();
    }
}

require_once __DIR__ . '/../utils/Logger.php';

/**
 * REQUEST LOGGING middleware – writes EVERY request to logs/info.log:
 *
 *   [2026-12-01 14:05:12] INFO GET /events 200 user=2 role=student 35ms
 *
 * Registered once in index.php:  Flight::before('start', ...)
 *
 * Why a shutdown function? The status code is only known at the very END of the request,
 * and some responses stop the script early (exit). PHP runs shutdown functions in every case.
 */
class RequestLogMiddleware
{
    public function before()
    {
        $start = microtime(true);

        register_shutdown_function(function () use ($start) {
            $request = Flight::request();
            $user = Flight::has('user') ? Flight::get('user') : null;

            Logger::info(sprintf(
                '%s %s %d user=%s role=%s %dms',
                $request->method,
                parse_url($request->url, PHP_URL_PATH),
                http_response_code(),
                $user['id'] ?? '-',
                $user['role'] ?? '-',
                round((microtime(true) - $start) * 1000)
            ));
        });
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/config.php';

/**
 * BaseDao of the TRAINER: the same methods as in your project,
 * but the connection is SQLite (a file in the browser) instead of MySQL.
 */
class BaseDao
{
    const DB_FILE = '/app/data/campusevents.sqlite';
    private static $connection = null;

    protected $table_name;
    protected $columns;

    public function __construct($table_name, $columns = [])
    {
        $this->table_name = $table_name;
        $this->columns = $columns;
    }

    public static function connection()
    {
        if (self::$connection === null) {
            $new = !is_file(self::DB_FILE);
            if (!is_dir(dirname(self::DB_FILE))) {
                mkdir(dirname(self::DB_FILE), 0777, true);
            }
            self::$connection = new PDO('sqlite:' . self::DB_FILE, null, null, [
                PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE => PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION,
                PDO::ATTR_DEFAULT_FETCH_MODE => PDO::FETCH_ASSOC
            ]);
            if ($new) {
                self::seed(self::$connection);
            }
        }
        return self::$connection;
    }

    private static function seed($db)
    {
        $db->exec("CREATE TABLE users (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, first_name TEXT NOT NULL, last_name TEXT NOT NULL,
                   email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, password TEXT NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'student', faculty TEXT NULL,
                   created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)");
        $db->exec("CREATE TABLE clubs (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT NOT NULL, description TEXT NULL)");
        $db->exec("CREATE TABLE events (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, club_id INTEGER NOT NULL, title TEXT NOT NULL,
                   location TEXT NOT NULL, starts_at TEXT NOT NULL)");
        $users = $db->prepare("INSERT INTO users (first_name, last_name, email, password, role, faculty) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)");
        $users->execute(['Admin', 'CampusEvents', 'admin@campusevents.ba', password_hash('Admin123!', PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 8]), 'admin', null]);
        $users->execute(['Ema', 'Kovač', 'ema@campusevents.ba', password_hash('Student123!', PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 8]), 'student', 'FENS']);
        // an OLD account whose password was stored as plain text (wrong!) – login must fail for it
        $users->execute(['Old', 'Account', 'plain@campusevents.ba', 'Plain123!', 'student', null]);
        $db->exec("INSERT INTO clubs (name, description) VALUES ('IT Club', 'Programming, hackathons'), ('Debate Club', 'Weekly debates'), ('Photo Club', 'Photo walks')");
        $db->exec("INSERT INTO events (club_id, title, location, starts_at) VALUES
                   (1, 'Intro to PHP', 'Lab A1', '2026-11-25 17:00:00'),
                   (1, 'Hackathon 2026', 'Main hall', '2026-12-05 09:00:00'),
                   (2, 'Debate night', 'Room B12', '2026-11-27 18:30:00')");
    }

    protected function query($query, $params = [])
    {
        $stmt = self::connection()->prepare($query);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        return $stmt->fetchAll();
    }

    protected function query_unique($query, $params = [])
    {
        $results = $this->query($query, $params);
        return $results[0] ?? null;
    }

    protected function execute($query, $params = [])
    {
        $stmt = self::connection()->prepare($query);
        $stmt->execute($params);
        return $stmt->rowCount();
    }

    public function get_all()
    {
        return $this->query("SELECT * FROM {$this->table_name} ORDER BY id");
    }

    public function get_by_id($id)
    {
        return $this->query_unique("SELECT * FROM {$this->table_name} WHERE id = :id", ['id' => $id]);
    }

    public function add($entity)
    {
        $entity = $this->only_columns($entity);
        $columns = array_keys($entity);
        $query = "INSERT INTO {$this->table_name} (" . implode(', ', $columns) . ") VALUES (:" . implode(', :', $columns) . ")";
        $this->execute($query, $entity);
        $entity['id'] = (int) self::connection()->lastInsertId();
        return $entity;
    }

    public function update($entity, $id)
    {
        $entity = $this->only_columns($entity);
        if (count($entity) === 0) {
            return 0;
        }
        $set = [];
        foreach (array_keys($entity) as $column) {
            $set[] = "$column = :$column";
        }
        $entity['id'] = $id;
        return $this->execute("UPDATE {$this->table_name} SET " . implode(', ', $set) . " WHERE id = :id", $entity);
    }

    public function delete($id)
    {
        return $this->execute("DELETE FROM {$this->table_name} WHERE id = :id", ['id' => $id]);
    }

    protected function only_columns($entity)
    {
        return array_intersect_key($entity, array_flip($this->columns));
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/UserService.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../dao/UserDao.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../utils/Logger.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../utils/Roles.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../config/config.php';

use Firebase\JWT\JWT;

class AuthService
{
    private $user_service;
    private $user_dao;

    public function __construct($user_service = null, $user_dao = null)
    {
        $this->user_service = $user_service ?? new UserService();
        $this->user_dao = $user_dao ?? new UserDao();
    }

    /** Create a student account and log the user in immediately. */
    public function register($data)
    {
        Validator::required($data, ['first_name', 'last_name', 'email', 'password']);
        if (isset($data['password_confirm']) && $data['password_confirm'] !== $data['password']) {
            throw new ValidationException('Passwords do not match.');
        }

        // Rule: everybody who registers is a STUDENT – never trust a "role" sent by the client
        $data['role'] = Roles::STUDENT;
        $user = $this->user_service->add($data);     // validates + hashes the password

        Logger::info("REGISTER user={$user['id']} email={$user['email']}");
        return ['user' => $user, 'token' => $this->create_token($user)];
    }

    public function login($data)
    {
        Validator::required($data, ['email', 'password']);
        $user = $this->user_dao->get_by_email(strtolower(trim($data['email'])));

        // Same message for "unknown email" and "wrong password" – do not tell attackers which emails exist
        if (!$user || !password_verify($data['password'], $user['password'])) {
            Logger::error("LOGIN FAILED email={$data['email']}");
            throw new UnauthorizedException('Invalid email or password.');
        }

        unset($user['password']);                     // never send the hash to the client
        Logger::info("LOGIN user={$user['id']} role={$user['role']}");
        return ['user' => $user, 'token' => $this->create_token($user)];
    }

    /** The logged-in user's own account. */
    public function get_profile($user_id)
    {
        return $this->user_service->get_by_id($user_id);
    }

    /** Users may change their name and password – NOT their email or role. */
    public function update_profile($user_id, $data)
    {
        $current = $this->user_service->get_by_id($user_id);
        if (!empty($data['password']) && ($data['password_confirm'] ?? null) !== $data['password']) {
            throw new ValidationException('Passwords do not match.');
        }
        $changes = array_merge($current, [
            'first_name' => $data['first_name'] ?? $current['first_name'],
            'last_name' => $data['last_name'] ?? $current['last_name'],
            'password' => $data['password'] ?? null
        ]);
        return $this->user_service->update($changes, $user_id);
    }

    /**
     * header.payload.signature – the payload is only Base64 encoded (anybody can READ it),
     * the signature (made with JWT_SECRET) proves that WE created it and nobody changed it.
     */
    private function create_token($user)
    {
        $payload = [
            'user' => [
                'id' => $user['id'],
                'email' => $user['email'],
                'first_name' => $user['first_name'],
                'last_name' => $user['last_name'],
                'role' => $user['role']
            ],
            'iat' => time(),                                   // issued at
            'exp' => time() + (int) Config::JWT_EXPIRATION()   // expires
        ];
        return JWT::encode($payload, Config::JWT_SECRET(), 'HS256');
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../utils/exceptions.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../utils/Validator.php';

/**
 * VERSION 3 (FINAL) – BaseService: common business logic for every entity.
 *
 * Problems are signalled with EXCEPTIONS (utils/exceptions.php) that carry an HTTP status code.
 *
 * Child services override validate() with their own rules and can override
 * any CRUD method when an entity needs special behaviour.
 * Services are the ONLY layer that calls the DAOs.
 */
class BaseService
{
    protected $dao;
    /** Used in error messages, e.g. "Event not found." */
    protected $entity_name = 'Entity';

    public function __construct($dao)
    {
        $this->dao = $dao;
    }

    public function get_all()
    {
        return $this->dao->get_all();
    }

    public function get_by_id($id)
    {
        $entity = $this->dao->get_by_id($id);
        if (!$entity) {
            throw new NotFoundException("{$this->entity_name} not found.");
        }
        return $entity;
    }

    public function add($entity)
    {
        $this->validate($entity);
        $created = $this->dao->add($entity);
        return $this->dao->get_by_id($created['id']);
    }

    public function update($entity, $id)
    {
        $this->get_by_id($id);              // 404 if it does not exist
        $this->validate($entity, $id);
        $this->dao->update($entity, $id);
        return $this->dao->get_by_id($id);
    }

    public function delete($id)
    {
        $this->get_by_id($id);
        $this->dao->delete($id);
    }

    /**
     * Throw a ValidationException when $entity breaks a rule.
     * $id is null when creating and the entity id when updating.
     */
    protected function validate($entity, $id = null)
    {
    }

    /** Turn empty strings into NULL for optional columns ("" is not a valid year or date). */
    protected function empty_to_null($entity, $fields)
    {
        foreach ($fields as $field) {
            if (array_key_exists($field, $entity) && trim((string) $entity[$field]) === '') {
                $entity[$field] = null;
            }
        }
        return $entity;
    }
}

<?php
require_once __DIR__ . '/BaseService.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../dao/UserDao.php';
require_once __DIR__ . '/../../utils/Roles.php';

class UserService extends BaseService
{
    const FACULTIES = ['FENS', 'FASS', 'FBA', 'FEDU'];

    protected $entity_name = 'User';

    public function __construct($dao = null)
    {
        parent::__construct($dao ?? new UserDao());
    }

    public function get_by_email($email)
    {
        return $this->dao->get_by_email($email);
    }

    /** Lab 4: validates the data and HASHES the password. Returns the user WITHOUT the hash. */
    public function add($user)
    {
        $user['role'] = $user['role'] ?? Roles::STUDENT;
        $user = $this->empty_to_null($user, ['faculty']);
        $this->validate($user);
        Validator::required($user, ['password']);
        Validator::password($user['password']);

        // Rule: passwords are NEVER stored in plain text
        $user['password'] = password_hash($user['password'], PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 8]);
        $user['email'] = strtolower(trim($user['email']));

        $created = $this->dao->add($user);
        return $this->dao->get_by_id($created['id']);
    }

    public function update($user, $id)
    {
        $this->get_by_id($id);
        $user = $this->empty_to_null($user, ['faculty']);
        $this->validate($user, $id);
        $user['email'] = strtolower(trim($user['email']));
        if (empty($user['password'])) {
            unset($user['password']);
        } else {
            Validator::password($user['password']);
            $user['password'] = password_hash($user['password'], PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 8]);
        }
        $this->dao->update($user, $id);
        return $this->dao->get_by_id($id);
    }

    protected function validate($user, $id = null)
    {
        Validator::required($user, ['first_name', 'last_name', 'email', 'role']);
        Validator::length($user['first_name'], 'first_name', 2, 50);
        Validator::length($user['last_name'], 'last_name', 2, 50);
        Validator::email($user['email']);
        Validator::one_of($user['role'], 'role', Roles::all());
        if (isset($user['faculty'])) {
            Validator::one_of($user['faculty'], 'faculty', self::FACULTIES);
        }
        $existing = $this->dao->get_by_email(strtolower(trim($user['email'])));
        if ($existing && $existing['id'] != $id) {
            throw new ValidationException("An account with this email already exists.");
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Writes one line per event into backend/logs/info.log or backend/logs/error.log
 *
 *   [2026-12-01 14:05:12] INFO GET /events 200 user=2 role=student 35ms
 *   [2026-12-01 14:05:13] ERROR POST /registrations 500 user=2 role=student PDOException: ... (RegistrationDao.php:42)
 */
class Logger
{
    const INFO_FILE = __DIR__ . '/../logs/info.log';
    const ERROR_FILE = __DIR__ . '/../logs/error.log';

    public static function info($message)
    {
        self::write(self::INFO_FILE, 'INFO', $message);
    }

    public static function error($message)
    {
        self::write(self::ERROR_FILE, 'ERROR', $message);
    }

    private static function write($file, $level, $message)
    {
        // "@" – a full disk or a missing permission must never crash the request itself
        if (!is_dir(dirname($file))) {
            @mkdir(dirname($file), 0775, true);
        }
        $line = sprintf("[%s] %s %s%s", date('Y-m-d H:i:s'), $level, $message, PHP_EOL);
        // LOCK_EX: two requests at the same time cannot mix their lines
        @file_put_contents($file, $line, FILE_APPEND | LOCK_EX);
    }
}

/**
 * Small reusable validation helpers for services.
 * Every method throws a ValidationException (HTTP 400) with a readable message.
 */
class Validator
{
    /** Every field in $fields must exist and must not be empty. */
    public static function required($data, $fields)
    {
        foreach ($fields as $field) {
            if (!isset($data[$field]) || trim((string) $data[$field]) === '') {
                throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' is required.");
            }
        }
    }

    public static function length($value, $field, $min, $max)
    {
        $length = mb_strlen(trim((string) $value));
        if ($length < $min || $length > $max) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must be between $min and $max characters long.");
        }
    }

    public static function email($value, $field = 'email')
    {
        if (!filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL)) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must be a valid email address.");
        }
    }

    public static function integer($value, $field, $min = null, $max = null)
    {
        if (filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_INT) === false) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must be a whole number.");
        }
        if ($min !== null && $value < $min) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must be at least $min.");
        }
        if ($max !== null && $value > $max) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must be at most $max.");
        }
    }

    public static function one_of($value, $field, $allowed)
    {
        if (!in_array($value, $allowed, true)) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must be one of: " . implode(', ', $allowed) . ".");
        }
    }

    public static function date($value, $field)
    {
        $date = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d', (string) $value);
        if (!$date || $date->format('Y-m-d') !== $value) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must be a date in the format YYYY-MM-DD.");
        }
    }

    /** Date and time as MySQL stores it: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS. */
    public static function datetime($value, $field)
    {
        $date = DateTime::createFromFormat('Y-m-d H:i:s', (string) $value);
        if (!$date || $date->format('Y-m-d H:i:s') !== $value) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must be a date and time in the format YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.");
        }
    }

    /** At least 8 characters, at least one letter and one digit. */
    public static function password($value, $field = 'password')
    {
        if (mb_strlen((string) $value) < 8 || !preg_match('/[A-Za-z]/', $value) || !preg_match('/\d/', $value)) {
            throw new ValidationException("Field '$field' must have at least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.");
        }
    }
}

use InvalidArgumentException;

     * @var string

     * @var string

     * @var string

     * @var int

            throw new InvalidArgumentException('JWK Set did not contain any keys');

            $kid = isset($v['kid']) ? $v['kid'] : $k;
            $keys[(string) $kid] = $v;

        return $keys;

                        $jwksResponse->getStatusCode(),
                        $jwksResponse->getReasonPhrase(),
                        $this->jwksUri,

                    $jwksResponse->getStatusCode()

            }
            $this->keySet = $this->formatJwksForCache((string) $jwksResponse->getBody());

            if (!isset($this->keySet[$keyId])) {
                return false;
            }

            $item = $this->getCacheItem();
            $item->set($this->keySet);
            if ($this->expiresAfter) {
                $item->expiresAfter($this->expiresAfter);
            }
            $this->cache->save($item);

        return true;

    {

            return false;
        }

        $cacheItem = $this->cache->getItem($this->rateLimitCacheKey);

        $cacheItemData = [];

            return true;

        $cacheItem->expiresAt($expiry);
        $this->cache->save($cacheItem);
        return false;

            throw new RuntimeException('JWKS URI is empty');

        // ensure we do not have illegal characters
        $key = preg_replace('|[^a-zA-Z0-9_\.!]|', '', $this->jwksUri);

        // add prefix

            $key = substr(hash('sha256', $key), 0, $this->maxKeyLength);

        $this->cacheKey = $key;

                $rateLimitKey = substr(hash('sha256', $rateLimitKey), 0, $this->maxKeyLength);

            $this->rateLimitCacheKey = $rateLimitKey;
        }

        $publicExponent = \pack('Ca*a*', 2, self::encodeLength(\strlen($exp)), $exp);

        $rsaPublicKey = \pack(
            'Ca*a*a*',
            48,
            self::encodeLength(\strlen($modulus) + \strlen($publicExponent)),
            $modulus,
            $publicExponent
        );

        $rsaOID = \pack('H*', '300d06092a864886f70d0101010500'); // hex version of MA0GCSqGSIb3DQEBAQUA

        $rsaPublicKey = \chr(3) . self::encodeLength(\strlen($rsaPublicKey)) . $rsaPublicKey;

        $rsaPublicKey = \pack(
            'Ca*a*',
            48,
            self::encodeLength(\strlen($rsaOID . $rsaPublicKey)),
            $rsaOID . $rsaPublicKey

     *
     * @param   string $oid the OID string
     * @return  string the binary DER-encoded OID
     */
    private static function encodeOID(string $oid): string
    {

        // Get the first octet
        $first = (int) array_shift($octets);
        $second = (int) array_shift($octets);
        $oid = \chr($first * 40 + $second);

        // Iterate over subsequent octets
        foreach ($octets as $octet) {
            if ($octet == 0) {
                $oid .= \chr(0x00);
                continue;
            }
            $bin = '';

            while ($octet) {
                $bin .= \chr(0x80 | ($octet & 0x7f));
                $octet >>= 7;
            }
            $bin[0] = $bin[0] & \chr(0x7f);

            // Convert to big endian if necessary
            if (pack('V', 65534) == pack('L', 65534)) {
                $oid .= strrev($bin);
            } else {
                $oid .= $bin;
            }
        }

        return $oid;

     *

     */
    private static function getKey(
        #[\SensitiveParameter] $keyOrKeyArray,
        ?string $kid

            return $keyOrKeyArray;

            throw new UnexpectedValueException('"kid" empty, unable to lookup correct key');
        }

        if ($keyOrKeyArray instanceof CachedKeySet) {

            return $keyOrKeyArray[$kid];
        }

        if (!isset($keyOrKeyArray[$kid])) {
            throw new UnexpectedValueException('"kid" invalid, unable to lookup correct key');
        }

        return $keyOrKeyArray[$kid];
    }

    /**
     * @param string $left  The string of known length to compare against
     * @param string $right The user-supplied string
     * @return bool
     */
    public static function constantTimeEquals(string $left, string $right): bool
    {
        if (\function_exists('hash_equals')) {
            return \hash_equals($left, $right);
        }
        $len = \min(self::safeStrlen($left), self::safeStrlen($right));

        $status = 0;
        for ($i = 0; $i < $len; $i++) {
            $status |= (\ord($left[$i]) ^ \ord($right[$i]));
        }
        $status |= (self::safeStrlen($left) ^ self::safeStrlen($right));

        return ($status === 0);
    }

     * @return void

    private static function handleJsonError(int $errno): void
    {

            JSON_ERROR_DEPTH => 'Maximum stack depth exceeded',
            JSON_ERROR_STATE_MISMATCH => 'Invalid or malformed JSON',
            JSON_ERROR_CTRL_CHAR => 'Unexpected control character found',
            JSON_ERROR_SYNTAX => 'Syntax error, malformed JSON',
            JSON_ERROR_UTF8 => 'Malformed UTF-8 characters' //PHP >= 5.3.3
        ];
        throw new DomainException(
            isset($messages[$errno])
            ? $messages[$errno]
            : 'Unknown JSON error: ' . $errno
        );

    protected function processMiddleware(Route $route, string $eventName): bool

        $middlewares = $eventName === Dispatcher::FILTER_BEFORE

            : array_reverse($route->middleware);

            if ($eventName === Dispatcher::FILTER_BEFORE && is_object($middleware) === true && ($middleware instanceof Closure)) {

            } elseif (is_string($middleware) === true) {

                        ob_end_clean();

                    throw new Exception(
                        "Middleware class '$middleware' not found. Is it being correctly autoloaded with Flight::path()?"
                    );
                }

                if (method_exists($middleware, $eventName) === false) {
                    continue;
                }

                $resolvedClass = null;

                // if there's a container assigned, we should use it to create the object
                if ($this->dispatcher->mustUseContainer($middleware) === true) {
                    $resolvedClass = $this->dispatcher->resolveContainerClass($middleware, $params);
                    // otherwise just assume it's a plain jane class, so inject the engine
                    // just like in Dispatcher::invokeCallable()
                } else {
                    $resolvedClass = new $middleware($this);
                }

                if ($resolvedClass === null) {
                    if (ob_get_level() > (getenv('PHPUNIT_TEST') ? 1 : 0)) {
                        ob_end_clean();
                    }

                    throw new Exception("Middleware class '$middleware' could not be resolved.");
                }

                $middlewareObject = [$resolvedClass, $eventName];
            }

            // If nothing was resolved, go to the next thing
            if ($middlewareObject === false) {
                continue;
            }

            // This is the way that v3 handles output buffering (which captures output correctly)
            $useV3OutputBuffering =
                $this->response()->v2_output_buffering === false &&
                $route->is_streamed === false;

            if ($useV3OutputBuffering === true) {
                ob_start();
            }

            // Here is the array callable $middlewareObject that we created earlier.
            // It looks bizarre but it's really calling [ $class, $method ]($params)
            // Which loosely translates to $class->$method($params)
            $start = microtime(true);
            $middlewareResult = $middlewareObject($params);

            $this->triggerEvent(
                'flight.middleware.executed',
                $route,
                $middleware,
                $eventName,
                microtime(true) - $start
            );

            if ($useV3OutputBuffering === true) {
                $this->response()->write(ob_get_clean());
            }

            // If you return false in your middleware, it will halt the request
            // and throw a 403 forbidden error by default.
            if ($middlewareResult === false) {
                $atLeastOneMiddlewareFailed = true;
                break;

        return $atLeastOneMiddlewareFailed;

    /**
     * Starts the framework.
     *
     * @throws Exception
     */
    public function _start(): void

        $self = $this;

        // This behavior is specifically for test suites, and for async platforms like swoole, workerman, etc.
        if ($this->requestHandled === false) {
            // not doing much here, just setting the requestHandled flag to true
            $this->requestHandled = true;

            // Allow filters to run
            // This prevents multiple after events from being registered
            $this->after('start', function () use ($self) {
                $self->stop();

        } else {
            // deregister the request and response objects and re-register them with new instances
            $this->unregister('request');
            $this->unregister('response');
            $this->register('request', Request::class);
            $this->register('response', Response::class);
            $this->router()->reset();

        $this->triggerEvent('flight.request.received', $request);

        $router = $this->router();

        if ($response->v2_output_buffering === true) {
            // Flush any existing output
            if (ob_get_length() > 0) {
                $response->write(ob_get_clean()); // @codeCoverageIgnore
            }

            // Enable output buffering
            // This is closed in the Engine->_stop() method
            ob_start();
        }

        // Route the request
        $failedMiddlewareCheck = false;
        while ($route = $router->route($request)) {
            $this->triggerEvent('flight.route.matched', $route);
            $params = array_values($route->params);

            // Add route info to the parameter list
            if ($route->pass) {
                $params[] = $route;

            if ($request->method === 'OPTIONS') {

                $response->status(204)
                    ->header('Allow', implode(', ', $allowedMethods))
                    ->send();
                return;

            if ($route->is_streamed === true) {
                if (count($route->streamed_headers) > 0) {
                    $response->status($route->streamed_headers['status'] ?? 200);
                    unset($route->streamed_headers['status']);
                    foreach ($route->streamed_headers as $header => $value) {
                        $response->header($header, $value);
                    }

                $response->header('X-Accel-Buffering', 'no');
                $response->header('Connection', 'close');

                // We obviously don't know the content length right now. This must be false.
                $response->content_length = false;
                $response->sendHeaders();
                $response->markAsSent();
            }

            // Run any before middlewares
            if (count($route->middleware) > 0) {
                $atLeastOneMiddlewareFailed = $this->processMiddleware($route, 'before');
                if ($atLeastOneMiddlewareFailed === true) {
                    $failedMiddlewareCheck = true;
                    break;
                }
                $this->triggerEvent('flight.middleware.before', $route);
            }

            $useV3OutputBuffering =
                $this->response()->v2_output_buffering === false &&
                $route->is_streamed === false;

            if ($useV3OutputBuffering === true) {
                ob_start();
            }

            // Call route handler
            $routeStart = microtime(true);
            $continue = $this->dispatcher->execute(
                $route->callback,
                $params
            );
            $this->triggerEvent('flight.route.executed', $route, microtime(true) - $routeStart);
            if ($useV3OutputBuffering === true) {
                $response->write(ob_get_clean());
            }

            // Run any after middlewares
            if (count($route->middleware) > 0) {
                // process the middleware in reverse order now
                $atLeastOneMiddlewareFailed = $this->processMiddleware($route, 'after');

                if ($atLeastOneMiddlewareFailed === true) {
                    $failedMiddlewareCheck = true;
                    break;
                }
                $this->triggerEvent('flight.middleware.after', $route);
            }

            $dispatched = true;

            if (!$continue) {
                break;
            }

            $router->next();

            $dispatched = false;
        }

        // HEAD requests should be identical to GET requests but have no body
        if ($request->method === 'HEAD') {
            $response->clearBody();
        }

        if ($failedMiddlewareCheck === true) {
            $this->halt(403, 'Forbidden', empty(getenv('PHPUNIT_TEST')));
        } elseif ($dispatched === false) {
            // Get the previous route and check if the method failed, but the URL was good.
            $lastRouteExecuted = $router->executedRoute;

            }
        }

     * @param string $route_alias Alias for the route.

        // url path. Note the '' in route()

/**
 * Json utility class for encoding and decoding JSON data.
 *
 * This class provides centralized JSON handling for the FlightPHP framework,
 * with consistent error handling and default options.
 */
class Json
{
    /**
     * Default JSON encoding options
     */
    public const DEFAULT_ENCODE_OPTIONS = JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR;

    /**
     * Default JSON decoding options
     */
    public const DEFAULT_DECODE_OPTIONS = JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR;

    /**
     * Encodes data to JSON string.
     *
     * @param mixed $data Data to encode
     * @param int $options JSON encoding options (bitmask)
     * @param int $depth Maximum depth
     *
     * @return string JSON encoded string
     * @throws Exception If encoding fails
     */
    public static function encode($data, int $options = 0, int $depth = 512): string
    {
        $options = $options | self::DEFAULT_ENCODE_OPTIONS; // Ensure default options are applied
        try {
            return json_encode($data, $options, $depth);
        } catch (JsonException $e) {
            throw new Exception('JSON encoding failed: ' . $e->getMessage(), $e->getCode(), $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Decodes JSON string to PHP data.
     *
     * @param string $json JSON string to decode
     * @param bool $associative Whether to return associative arrays instead of objects
     * @param int $depth Maximum decoding depth
     * @param int $options JSON decoding options (bitmask)
     *
     * @return mixed Decoded data
     * @throws Exception If decoding fails
     */
    public static function decode(string $json, bool $associative = false, int $depth = 512, int $options = 0)
    {
        $options = $options | self::DEFAULT_DECODE_OPTIONS; // Ensure default options are applied
        try {
            return json_decode($json, $associative, $depth, $options);
        } catch (JsonException $e) {
            throw new Exception('JSON decoding failed: ' . $e->getMessage(), $e->getCode(), $e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Checks if a string is valid JSON.
     *
     * @param string $json String to validate
     *
     * @return bool True if valid JSON, false otherwise
     */
    public static function isValid(string $json): bool
    {
        try {
            json_decode($json, false, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            return true;
        } catch (JsonException $e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Gets the last JSON error message.
     *
     * @return string Error message or empty string if no error
     */
    public static function getLastError(): string
    {
        $error = json_last_error();
        if ($error === JSON_ERROR_NONE) {
            return '';
        }
        return json_last_error_msg();
    }

    /**
     * Pretty prints JSON data.
     *
     * @param mixed $data Data to encode
     * @param int $additionalOptions Additional options to merge with pretty print
     *
     * @return string Pretty formatted JSON string
     * @throws Exception If encoding fails
     */
    public static function prettyPrint($data, int $additionalOptions = 0): string
    {
        $options = self::DEFAULT_ENCODE_OPTIONS | JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | $additionalOptions;
        return self::encode($data, $options);
    }
